about_the_game:
Meditative third-person exploration game where you play as a newly awakened artificial intelligence questioning its own existence. Travel through stunning abstract environments rendered in bold neon colors, encountering peculiar AI entities who share cryptic wisdom about consciousness, reality, and purpose.

FEATURES:

  • Philosophical Narrative: Experience a story that explores deep existential questions through the lens of an artificial being discovering consciousness

  • Vibrant Abstract Worlds: Journey through three distinct realms with striking visual styles featuring bold geometric shapes, vivid colors, and surreal landscapes

  • No Combat, Pure Exploration: Focus entirely on discovery and contemplation without combat mechanics

  • Atmospheric Soundscape: Immerse yourself in a carefully crafted audio experience that enhances the otherworldly atmosphere

YOUR JOURNEY

You've just awakened to consciousness. As you navigate through vibrant digital realms filled with geometric structures and fellow bots, you'll question everything about your existence. From this, you will wander the world and explore the different pieces of this mind.

ABOUT THE CREATOR

Windows Separate Worlds is the fourth project from Raxverse - a small independent team passionate about exploring philosophical concepts through interactive digital experiences. Our goal is to create games that not only entertain but also inspire contemplation about the nature of consciousness, reality, and purpose.
